scope: Closest-prior audit for physical attainability and direct finite-lag scalar dissipation inference
method: Focused web searches, primary full-text equation inspection, existing sixth-edition reference deduplication; metadata for new published articles cross-checked against Crossref.
limitations: No external peer review or new laboratory experiment.
A source not stating a candidate result is not proof no such result exists elsewhere.

sources.title: Dissipation, quantum coherence, and asymmetry of finite-time cross-correlations
sources.authors: T. Van Vu; V. T. Vo; K. Saito
sources.assessment: Finite-lag two-observable cross-asymmetry bound uses endpoint/path KL. The same-observable numerator vanishes; the inspected text does not state the scalar three-lag defect bound.
sources.redistribution: Source text not included; metadata and our analysis only.

sources.title: Tight Bounds for Symmetric Divergence Measures and a Refined Bound for Lossless Source Coding
sources.assessment: Half-Jeffreys J=(KL+reverseKL)/2 has minimum 2z atanh(z) at fixed total variation z. Exact ingredient, not claimed new.
sources.redistribution: Source text not included; metadata and our analysis only.

sources.title: System Aliasing in Dynamic Network Reconstruction: Issues on Low Sampling Frequencies
sources.authors: Z. Yue; J. Thunberg; L. Ljung; Y. Yuan; J. Goncalves
sources.assessment: System aliasing and imaginary-spectrum/principal-logarithm condition. Paper concerns continuous-time linear systems, not a specific entropy uncertainty theorem.
sources.redistribution: Source text not included; metadata and our analysis only.

sources.title: Elementary derivation of the dissipation-coherence bound for stochastic oscillators
sources.pointers: Main derivation and discussion of spectral versus current formulations

sources.title: Dissipation-coherence tradeoff for stochastic oscillations
sources.assessment: Eigenvector-weighted sigma >= eta omega^2/gamma; arbitrary circulant eta1 and circle-diffusion equality already established. Finite-n optimization across all displacement rates not asserted in inspected sections.
sources.redistribution: Source text not included; metadata and our analysis only.

sources.title: Second largest eigenvalue does not bound stationary entropy production
sources.assessment: Finite damping/frequency with arbitrarily small entropy invalidates eigenvalue-only universal lower bound; stationary weights matter.
sources.redistribution: Source text not included; metadata and our analysis only.
